business_summary: Centum Electronics Limited designs, manufactures, and exports electronic products In Europe, Middle East, Asia, and North America. It engages in design, development, production, and manufacturing of energy management controllers, electrical AC and DC converters, embedded computers, test means, digital and hardware in the loop simulators, actuator controllers, and smart actuators for auxiliary functions. The company also provides satellite bus systems, test tools, power management, and LRU and data recorders; onboard computer systems, receiver and seeker electronics, transmit receive modules, high power RF amplifier, digital receivers, ELINT controllers, power conditioning and processing unit, and radar finger printing systems; and energy conversion and storage systems, passenger information systems, and specialist engineering services and manufacturing services. In addition, it offers automotive telematic module, automotive flexray demonstrator, power steering encoder system, and assisted car navigation, a passive rollover avoidance system, as well as automotive elecboard for solar roof; and industrial equipment diagnosis, solar energy power cabinet, industrial breaker control system, and HIL test simulator turbo alternator regulation. Further, the company provides medical electronic board, medical product test area, medical flat panel acquisition board, and medical panel for surgery room; base station equipment and RF filters; and diagnosis and repair services for a range of telecom base station equipment. It serves aerospace, space, defense, transportation, automotive, industry and energy, medical, and communication sectors. The company was formerly known as Solectron Centum Electronics Limited and changed its name to Centum Electronics Limited in December 2007. Centum Electronics Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
